verdict.rationale: There is no explicit bulk-edit feature or bulk API endpoint in the evidence. A user could approximate bulk operations by scripting the REST API, which is documented for creating and updating tasks and projects and is confirmed live behind API-key auth. The AI also reschedules an entire day or week at once, but that is automatic rescheduling, not user-directed bulk actions. Missing for 10: a native multi-select or bulk-edit UI, batch API endpoints, documented bulk update/delete/reassign across many items, and hands-on corroboration.
